answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the cipher until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the dawn of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit.
